# Democracy in Everyday Life

<!-- STEP id="outside-government" -->
## Outside the Government Too

Civil society organisations, socio-religious and community institutions, cooperatives and trade unions often decide in a democratic way too.

A **cooperative** is a group formed to work for a common benefit. Its members share profits and responsibilities equally.

<!-- STEP id="bridges" -->
## Bridges to the State

These groups act as bridges between citizens and the State. They work through Public Interest Litigation (PIL), campaigns and community organisations.

**They help make democracy more inclusive and responsive.**
